ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 9:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous areas dominate both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels are mapped to the trailing edge perimeter and a vertical, semi-continuous column at the median notch. Sparse low-intensity focal points (speckling) are distributed across the primary white surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with an approximate 55-degree interior angle at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed along the entire trailing edge. Notable high-amplitude textured irregularities (protrusions) at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating at the median notch and sweeping upward/outward toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured pixel clusters at the lateral lobe tips consistent with biological growth. Isolated dark pixel clusters (spots) are visible in the interior regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive textured protrusions at the lateral lobe extremities consistent with barnacle colonization.
